description: Expert-roundtable decision framework: the AI convenes a panel of experts with conflicting stances who cross-examine one issue from several angles and shape it into 2–3 candidate options, one recommendation, and the evidence each candidate still lacks. The vote shows where the experts lean, not a verdict; the human confirms before anything lands. Includes four tables (role / blind / human / contrarian) drawing on four sources of cognitive diversity, a three-dimension role-generation spec, a "will forgetting this hurt tomorrow?" persistence gate, an optional outside seat (a blind answer from another vendor's model), and a four-layer knowledge-immunity model. For solo developers and small teams making architecture, priority, and trade-off decisions. Invoke explicitly.
